description: This file implements tensor rearrangement functionality, including the core 'rearrange' function similar to 'einops.rearrange'. It defines internal functions to create rearrangement callables based on patterns, and provides examples of tensor transformations such as permuting axes, reshaping, stacking, and splitting images.

classes.description: Represents anonymous axes (unnamed dimensions) in rearrangement patterns.

methods.description: Creates and memoizes a callable that performs tensor rearrangement based on a specified pattern and axes lengths.
